tier1.text: The fibula, or calf bone, mainly gives muscles a place to attach. It runs down the outer side of the calf, from the knee to the ankle. Unlike the tibia, or shin bone, it does not carry the body's weight. Its lower end forms the bony bump on the outer side of the ankle.
